Blocks only this page

Blocks pages under this site and path only
────────
For example, if you enter baidu.com/search, baidu.com/search and baidu.com/search/1 will be hidden, but baidu.com/news will stay visible.

webdav_credentials_hint.message: The app password stays on this device. The server address, folder and username sync to your other devices through your browser.

webdav_password_hint.message: The server address, folder and username sync to your other devices through your browser, but the app password doesn’t. Keep it somewhere safe to enter on new devices.

webdav_password_hint_synced.message: The server address, folder and username came from your other device. The app password doesn’t sync, so enter it here.

webdav_choice_hint.message: The server already has Lumno settings. Keep one side, or merge wallpapers from both and keep the server’s other settings. This device’s data is backed up first.

webdav_conflict_hint.message: This device and the server changed the same thing. Pick a version to keep; other changes merge automatically.

webdav_error_endpoint.message: Enter a valid HTTPS WebDAV address.

webdav_error_directory.message: Enter a valid sync folder name.

webdav_error_credentials.message: Enter a username and app password.

webdav_error_auth.message: Authentication failed. Check the username and app password.

webdav_error_permission.message: Access denied. Check the folder’s read and write permissions.

webdav_error_rate.message: The server rate limit was reached. Try again later.

webdav_error_capacity.message: WebDAV storage is full. Free up space and try again.

webdav_error_conditional.message: This server cannot reliably prevent concurrent overwrites and is not supported for automatic sync.

webdav_error_changed.message: Settings changed during sync. Local data is retained and sync will retry.

webdav_error_missing.message: Remote settings were deleted. Choose to upload local settings to recreate them, or check the server address.

webdav_error_chrome_capacity.message: These settings exceed Chrome sync capacity and were not applied. Existing Chrome sync and local data are preserved. Reduce the settings and try again.

webdav_error_network.message: Connection failed or timed out. Check the network, server address and certificate. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_storage.message: Sync data could not be saved. Check the browser’s local storage.

webdav_error_shortcuts.message: Restoring would exceed the shortcut limit. Remove some local folder shortcuts first.

webdav_error_remote_unreadable.message: The server did not return the remote settings normally. Check the server or try again later. Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_remote_corrupt.message: The remote settings file is damaged (not valid JSON), possibly from an interrupted upload or another app. Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_invalid_state.message: The remote settings use a structure or version this Lumno doesn’t recognize, possibly from a newer release. Update Lumno on every device. Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_state_too_large.message: The remote settings exceed the sync limit (60 shortcuts, 256 wallpapers, 2 MB of settings). Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_response_too_large.message: A file returned by the server exceeds the 2 MB limit. Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_invalid_shortcuts.message: The remote shortcut data is invalid (malformed or duplicate IDs). Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_invalid_icon.message: The remote shortcut icon records are invalid. Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_invalid_wallpaper.message: The remote wallpaper records are invalid (bad ID or dimensions). Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_invalid_asset.message: A remote image is invalid (wrong type, size or content). Local data was not replaced.

webdav_error_asset_missing.message: An image file is missing on the server, possibly from an unfinished upload or a deleted file. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_asset_integrity.message: An image file on the server is damaged (its content doesn’t match the record). Local data is retained.

webdav_error_local_invalid_state.message: This device’s settings have an invalid structure and can’t be synced. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_state_too_large.message: This device’s settings exceed the sync limit (256 wallpapers, 2 MB of settings). Remove some wallpapers and try again. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_invalid_shortcuts.message: This device’s shortcut data is invalid (malformed or duplicate IDs) and can’t be synced. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_invalid_icon.message: This device’s shortcut icon records are invalid and can’t be synced. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_invalid_wallpaper.message: This device’s wallpaper records are invalid (bad ID or dimensions) and can’t be synced. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_invalid_asset.message: An image on this device is damaged or unsupported and can’t be synced. Remove it and add it again. Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_local_asset_too_large.message: An image on this device exceeds the sync limit (96 KB per icon, 2 MB per wallpaper). Nothing was changed on either side.

webdav_error_shortcut_id_conflict.message: A remote shortcut shares an ID with a bookmark folder shortcut on this device, so they can’t be merged. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_write_failed.message: The server refused to write the sync files. Check the folder’s write permission and free space. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_directory_unavailable.message: Couldn’t create the sync folder on the server. Check the server address and folder permissions.

webdav_error_folder_create_refused.message: The server refused to create a new folder (MKCOL 405), so the sync lock can’t be set up. Check that the account can create folders, the mount isn’t read-only, and no proxy blocks MKCOL.

webdav_error_http.message: The server returned an error (HTTP {status}). Try again later. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_generic.message: Sync failed. Try again later. Local data is retained.

webdav_error_merge_too_large.message: Together the wallpapers exceed the sync limit (256 wallpapers, 2 MB of settings, 8 KB of image links). Remove some, or keep one side. Nothing was changed.

webdav_test_success.message: Connection, read/write and concurrent update protection verified

webdav_error_interrupted.message: The previous replacement was interrupted. Uploads are paused. Restore the previous local settings, or reconnect and use the remote settings.

webdav_missing_hint.message: The settings on the server are gone. Upload this device's settings again, or check the server address first.

webdav_error_locked.message: Another device is writing to the server. Try again later. If it stays blocked, follow the WebDAV guide to recover a leftover lock.

webdav_error_lock_recovery.message: The remote write could not finish safely, so its protection was kept. Pause sync on every device and confirm the interrupted request has ended before removing v1/write-lock from the remote sync directory.

webdav_error_outdated.message: Reload the Lumno extension, then refresh settings to use multiple WebDAV connections.

webdav_beta_hint.message: In beta: sync settings, custom icons and wallpapers through a WebDAV drive or NAS. Unlike browser built-in sync, it works across browsers and covers icons and wallpapers.

webdav_setup_hint.message: Sync settings, custom icons and wallpapers through Nutstore or another WebDAV service, alongside browser sync.

webdav_error_duplicate.message: A connection with the same server, folder and username already exists.

webdav_error_interrupted_other.message: Another WebDAV connection ({name}) needs to restore local settings first. This one resumes afterwards.

webdav_remove_confirm.message: Delete this local connection? Files on the server will be kept.
